findings.finding: NAM102 stores the complete Unicode field values but displays differently across renderers. Poppler omits the CJK names and some extended Latin glyphs; MuPDF displays CJK via fallback. Portable appearance is not established.

NAM102 caption first names shrink to 4.43 pt. Other fixed fields clip names rather than wrapping: applicant surname, child-list surnames, and adult/minor printed names at the signature area. MuPDF also clips the bottom of the property-description field before its addendum continuation. No off-page geometry flags were raised; visual inspection is necessary.

Three included children age 14 or older are entered in the optional signer field, but NAM102 still has one minor signature/date line and a clipped single-line printed-name field. No extra signature sheet is generated.

Six Hennepin orders (adult plus five children) occupy 22 pages, including footer-only pages 7, 11, 15, and 19. Numbered findings continue across separate orders instead of restarting. Each order retains its judicial signature area.

working_behavior: All 60 numbered statement sections are visible across NAM102 addendum pages; long statements also reach the end marker in the proposed order.
All 30 fee-explanation items and the unbroken ending marker are preserved; signature/date/perjury content remains together on page 3.
Six release pages retain separate names and signature lines.
Companion DOCX-derived CJK order and release text retains the test names.
limitations: Synthetic stress configurations only; not every form combination or writing system.
No mobile, keyboard, screen-reader or tagged-PDF-order audit performed in this batch.
Defective PDFs are retained as baseline evidence, not approved filing documents.

pdf_renderers: Poppler in pinned Docassemble Docker image
repair.unsupported_scripts: Only the fixture scripts are claimed; unsupported code points fail explicitly. No universal Unicode or shaping support claim.

baseline_interpretation: Use the latest Latin/family scenarios and the first-run CJK case: two automated failures, one text-pass with visual defects. The first fee marker failure was a line-break artifact; the corrected unbroken marker passes. Known failures remain failures; no assertions suppressed.
interpretation: Final verification passes 9 scenarios / 208 steps, 25 Python regressions, 10 navigation/expiry checks, and independent downloaded-application structure checks. Baseline failures are retained for provenance.
